title: Evolving Hate Speech Online: An Adaptive Framework for Detection and Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Manual qualitative analysis comparing predictions of the proposed hybrid model with the Google Moderate Hate Speech API, specifically observing false positives generated by the API on benign social media posts that mention Black identity.
Qualitative evaluation and case study analysis of model predictions to identify false negatives in detecting implicit sexual harassment and targeted toxicity toward women.
